{{Quote|Warning! Do not approach the base! All our personnel have been infected by the bacteria which cause Direllian Plague, a deadly respiratory disease which incubates in hours and kills within days.|Part of Commander Astred's broadcast message requesting help|<ref name="QM" />}}
[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Astred''' was in charge of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Tiragga Alliance outpost|base]] on the [[Second moon of Tiragga|second]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tiragga]]. When the base's personnel contracted the [[Direllian Plague]], [[Gender/Legends|he]] sent out a continuous broadcast message warning ships to stay away from the base, and to head to [[Kirtania]] to procure [[Shiarha Root]] and the aid of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[T'Jaleq Kith'Araquia]] to treat the plague.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The planet Kirtania lies within two days travels through hyperspace. According to our medical records, Kirtania is one of the few planets where Shiarha Root grows.|Part of Commander Astred's broadcast message requesting help|<ref name="QM" />}}
Astred was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], assigned as the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Tiragga Alliance outpost|outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tiragga]]'s [[Second moon of Tiragga|second moon]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the base's personnel were struck down by the [[Direllian Plague]], a virulent respiratory diseases that could kill in several [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. Astred contracted the disease himself, but remained on duty in his office. One of the base's medics, [[Keldon]], recommended sending someone to the nearby planet [[Kirtania]] to acquire [[Shiarha Root]] and enlist the help of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[T'Jaleq Kith'Araquia]], the [[Araquia]] who had first treated the plague. Astred agreed with the idea, but refused to send any of the base personnel on the errand for fear that they would be unable to complete the task. Instead, he enlisted Keldon to help him reprogram a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to send out a continuous broadcast message. He hoped that returning supply [[Starship/Legends|ships]] would hear the message and assist them.<ref name="QM" />

{{RPG}}
Astred's actions proved correct, and a returning transport crew diverted to Kirtania, obtaining the necessary materials to cure the plague and save the base personnel.<ref name="QM" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Come on, Keldon, we have to get the droid set up with a continuous broadcast message before we collapse too. Then all we can do is wait&mdash;and hope.|Commander Astred rallies Keldon during the outbreak of Direllian Plague at their outpost|<ref name="QM" />}}
Astred was an old man during the time of the Galactic Civil War, but was capable of base command. He refused to abandon his duties despite being affected by the Direllian Plague, and was determined to save the personnel under his command.<ref name="QM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Astred appeared in ''[[The Quality of Mercy]]'', an [[Roleplaying game|RPG adventure]] written by [[Nicky Rea]] published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 1|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 1]] by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]]. Astred can die during the adventure if the player characters take too long during their adventure on Kirtania. This article assumes that the player characters successfully completed the task as recommended.
